brief:
Analysts attribute Democrats' historic congressional gains in November's midterm elections to what observers call a "blue tsunami," according to Dawn. The party secured majorities in both the House and Senate, positioning itself for a confrontational relationship with President Donald Trump over the coming two years.

The electoral outcome may reshape debates over U.S. military assistance to Israel, with some analysts suggesting the newly empowered Democratic majority could challenge existing aid arrangements.
dek: Analysts have spent much time over the past week trying to explain the “blue tsunami” that swept the United States during the Nov. 3 midterm elections. Democrats gained historic majorities in both the House and Senate, teeing up for a confrontational two years with President Donald Trump.
title: Democratic midterm gains set stage for Israel aid fight
